text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived. With a fresh 
mindset, Verxina continued training hard, 
setting her sights on the Osaka Hai.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you don't need to go home for 
New Year's?

Are you sure you don't need to go home for 
New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have to make up for the time when I 
couldn't focus, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first comes endurance running. 
Let us begin right away!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...You seem to be doing well. Thank 
goodness..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best too...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I say. Before that, I gotta heal 
this injury... Haha.
(Shiver)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...A news notification?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! This...!

Just as we returned to the academy... I 
had to break the news to her that I had 
caught wind of earlier. And that news was—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Orfevre-san will be entering the Osaka 
Hai."

After the Japan Cup, Orfevre rested for a 
while to recover from fatigue. And now—she 
makes her move once more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Um, Orfe-san is...

"After that, she fell completely silent. 
Her wavering expression, however... 
gradually settled into firm resolve."
choice_data_list:
...Could you give me until the end of 
today?

...Could you give me until the end of 
today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
I'll see if I can come up with an even 
better routine!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please. I'll make sure to get plenty of 
rest in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... Verxina-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Orfe-san is... When you actually face her 
head-on, she's completely different, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Up close, her sheer intensity and 
pushiness are way crazier than how it 
looks from the outside...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So... you called out to me because you 
were worried, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Look, things were finally starting to 
go so well. If we ran into someone like 
that again... it's just..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I heard that... Shion-san took special 
care of things back then. Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there is no problem. ...After all, 
I am quite used to monsters.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ha! She's in a whole different league from 
ordinary monsters—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...The person I speak of also possesses 
matchless power, however.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I mean... That girl is basically a 
walking natural disaster—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, that doesn't even matter! More 
importantly..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, you look... more okay than I 
expected, huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Shion-san. I'm truly so grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because I had that time... I was able to 
face my true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...That is why, I... want to make a 
promise once more.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A promise...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If, in the Osaka Hai... I can defeat what 
is 'absolute' to you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If I can prove I can reach the top even 
from here... —that would be of help to 
you, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: D-Does that mean... she's going to—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, by all means, come to the Osaka 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I will win. —For your sake, as well.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
... I was thinking about this before, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Why... are you doing so much for me? For 
someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I understand doing things 'for my little 
sisters'... ...Well, actually, it doesn't 
really resonate with me. Because for me... 
it's for my own sake."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Why are you trying to shoulder my burdens 
too... when I don't even have anything to 
do with this?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am not that soft-hearted. I have no 
intention of carrying everything on my 
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Then... why?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Please tell me, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. I know this is very rude to say to 
an elder, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I felt like she resembled my little 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, little sister? Seriously?!!!

After parting ways with Verxina and 
rethinking the menu... she contacted me.

It seems she's unsure of how best to take 
a breather. From the options she brought 
up, I suggested—
choice_data_list:
Praying to grow stronger together with 
Cheval.

Tarumae's recommended New Year's local 
goods fair

text_block_list.text:
Keeping the future in mind, I want to see 
how Verxina refreshes herself. So, I 
decided to observe her for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hngh...! Ngnnnnnnghhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fuhee... My body feels like it's about to 
twist right off~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still, isn't that amazing! You couldn't 
even do some of those poses before. You 
really are quite flexible, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Looks like it♪ Teacher praised me 
too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're right, that's truly amazing! Good 
girl, good girl!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So―― You can do the super advanced pose 
too, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, don—huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's do our best♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah~~! Trainer, help meee! It's gonna 
fall offfff~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not allowed. You can do it, you can 
do it, give it your all! ...Fufu♪

If I was going, I wanted to pray for her 
growth. After messaging her that I'd come 
along, I hurried off to the shrine—
(Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. For accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You too, Cheval. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. I just hadn't gone yet. 
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Sis... Did you make sure to make a wish 
for yourself, too?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I thought so too, so I... said a prayer 
for you as well, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...! Cheval... thank you.

Interested in a local products fair 
recommended by Verxina's roommate, Hokko 
Tarumae, I decided to accompany her for a 
little while.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Take a look! This is the sweets booth!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido has a flourishing dairy industry, 
too, so milk chocolates are simply the 
best!

It seemed to be a Hokkaido product fair, 
and the sheer variety of local specialties 
caught our eyes. Verxina was also gazing 
around happily, but—
choice_data_list:
Are you thinking about your little 
sisters, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes... I was thinking of buying some 
souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: In that case! The ultimate star sweet is—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haskap berries from Tomakomai, right? Of 
course, I'll happily take some.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ever since you recommended it to me, I've 
been completely hooked. It's great for 
beauty too, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Could you pick out three good ones for me?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yay! But of course! Thank you very much 
for your purchase~♪
